description: Find issues, optionally filtered by a text query (matches title), team key, workflow-state name, or assignee email. Read-only. GraphQL: query issues(filter, first).

assigneeEmail.description: Filter to issues assigned to this user email.

query.description: Free text to match against issue titles (containsIgnoreCase).

teamKey.description: Team key, e.g. "ENG". Filters to that team.

name: linear_search_issues
title: Search / filter issues
